test_cases.description: Verify that Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope rises 4 +/- 2 ms after Hi_Enable_Envelope rising edge under normal conditions.
test_cases.initial_condition: Hi_Enable_Envelope is low.
test_cases.test_inputs: Apply a single rising edge to Hi_Enable_Envelope.
test_cases.expected_result: Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope rises with a delay of 4 +/- 2 ms.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Measured delay between rising edges is between 2 ms and 6 ms.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Use a high‑resolution timer to capture the timestamps of the rising edges of Hi_Enable_Envelope and Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope. Repeat the test multiple times to confirm consistency.

test_cases.description: Boundary test for lower delay limit: confirm that the delay is not less than 2 ms.
test_cases.initial_condition: Hi_Enable_Envelope is low.
test_cases.test_inputs: Apply a single rising edge to Hi_Enable_Envelope.
test_cases.expected_result: Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope rises no earlier than 2 ms after Hi_Enable_Envelope rising edge.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Measured delay >= 2 ms.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Use a high‑resolution timer to capture timestamps. Verify that the delay is not below 2 ms.

test_cases.description: Boundary test for upper delay limit: confirm that the delay does not exceed 6 ms.
test_cases.initial_condition: Hi_Enable_Envelope is low.
test_cases.test_inputs: Apply a single rising edge to Hi_Enable_Envelope.
test_cases.expected_result: Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope rises no later than 6 ms after Hi_Enable_Envelope rising edge.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Measured delay <= 6 ms.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Use a high‑resolution timer to capture timestamps. Verify that the delay is not above 6 ms.

test_cases.description: Verify that the LRU delays the rising edge of Valve_On to Valve_On_Delay by approximately 4 ms.
test_cases.initial_condition: Valve_On is low; Valve_On_Delay is low.
test_cases.test_inputs: Apply a rising edge to Valve_On at time t0.
test_cases.expected_result: Valve_On_Delay rises at time t0 + Δt where Δt is between 2 ms and 6 ms inclusive.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Measured Δt ≥ 2 ms and ≤ 6 ms.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Use a high‑resolution timer to capture the timestamps of the Valve_On rising edge and the subsequent Valve_On_Delay rising edge. Repeat the test multiple times to confirm consistency.

test_cases.description: Boundary test for the lower limit of the delay (2 ms).
test_cases.initial_condition: Valve_On is low; Valve_On_Delay is low.
test_cases.test_inputs: Apply a rising edge to Valve_On at time t0.
test_cases.expected_result: Valve_On_Delay rises at time t0 + Δt where Δt is at least 2 ms.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Measured Δt ≥ 2 ms and ≤ 6 ms.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Configure the system to operate at its minimum delay setting if configurable, or use the fastest possible hardware path. Verify that the delay does not fall below 2 ms.

test_cases.description: Boundary test for the upper limit of the delay (6 ms).
test_cases.initial_condition: Valve_On is low; Valve_On_Delay is low.
test_cases.test_inputs: Apply a rising edge to Valve_On at time t0.
test_cases.expected_result: Valve_On_Delay rises at time t0 + Δt where Δt is at most 6 ms.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Measured Δt ≥ 2 ms and ≤ 6 ms.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Configure the system to operate at its maximum delay setting if configurable, or use the slowest possible hardware path. Verify that the delay does not exceed 6 ms.

test_cases.description: Verify Speed_Loop_Clear is TRUE when Low_Threshold_Anomaly_NodeB_Monitor is TRUE and Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope is TRUE.

test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Evaluate the OR condition; since Low_Threshold_Anomaly_NodeB_Monitor is TRUE, the result should be TRUE regardless of Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope.

test_cases.description: Verify Speed_Loop_Clear is TRUE when Low_Threshold_Anomaly_NodeB_Monitor is FALSE and Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope is FALSE.
test_cases.expected_result: Speed_Loop_Clear = TRUE
test_cases.pass_criteria: Speed_Loop_Clear must be set to TRUE.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Since Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope is FALSE, the OR condition evaluates to TRUE.

test_cases.description: Verify Speed_Loop_Clear is FALSE when Low_Threshold_Anomaly_NodeB_Monitor is FALSE and Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope is TRUE.
test_cases.expected_result: Speed_Loop_Clear = FALSE
test_cases.pass_criteria: Speed_Loop_Clear must be set to FALSE.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Both inputs are FALSE for the OR condition, so Speed_Loop_Clear should be FALSE.

test_cases.description: Verify Speed_Loop_Clear is TRUE when Low_Threshold_Anomaly_NodeB_Monitor is TRUE and Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope is FALSE.
test_cases.expected_result: Speed_Loop_Clear = TRUE
test_cases.pass_criteria: Speed_Loop_Clear must be set to TRUE.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Either input being TRUE satisfies the OR condition, resulting in Speed_Loop_Clear = TRUE.
